day.headline: A Snake day — Ox and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Monkey pairs with Snake — a harmonious day
signs.motif: a podcast episode queued for weeks
signs.message: That episode's been sitting in your queue for weeks. Play it now.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the bag with a broken strap
signs.message: Take the strap to someone who fixes things. Today, not eventually.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Do the one you always skip. Ninety seconds on the floor.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You forgot you pay for that. Cancel it before lunch.

reasons: Pig opposes Snake — a day to take slowly
signs.message: The pair blocking the door goes back on the shelf. Thirty seconds.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Move it now while you remember. One call, no apology.

reasons: Ox and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a window open in the dark
signs.message: It's been open since sundown. Latch it, then get comfortable.

reasons: Rooster and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Day three is the wobbly one. Do it badly, still counts.

reasons: Snake's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Not the coat for tonight. Fine reason to keep tonight small.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: dinner eaten at the wrong hour
signs.message: You ate dinner at four. Let the whole evening go soft.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the version you did not send
signs.message: The one you kept to yourself stays in drafts. Nothing lost.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You yessed too fast this morning. Untangle it tomorrow, rest tonight.
